hypotheses.H10_gauge_trunk: The finite SU(2)/SU(3) heat closure, one-loop coefficients (33/5,1,-3), tree weak fixed point and beta_EW=4 define the declared D10 branch.
hypotheses.H11_representation_attachment: The selected D3 group heat law is represented faithfully by six conjugation channels on native W5, without an added regular submodule. Selecting this background, transposition-only jumps and the physical heat/three-generation readout remains assumed; it is not the native full-seam generator or the A5-triplet restriction.
hypotheses.H12_ordering: Increasing entries of the up/down output vectors label (u,c,t)/(d,s,b); no CKM or right-family frame is inferred.
hypotheses.H1_family_response_carrier: The physical response is identified with the native A5-irreducible W5 and a supplied face-axis D3 background. Its restriction F=1+2+2 and dimensions5,4 are certified; this physical identification and background are assumed.

hypotheses.H3_effects_and_signs: The remaining composite effect ranks, orientations and sector signs are physical. The common exposure specifically uses the normalized quadratic color-Casimir observable on the native D3 line, not a rank-four invariant color projector; that physical response choice is assumed.
hypotheses.H4_cumulant_law: A5 symmetry suffices for normalized trace on native W5. Isotropy on the composite modules, Gaussian two-cumulant truncation and the order of color contraction versus nonlinear response remain hypotheses; negative terms require a separate signed-response law.
hypotheses.H5_family_attachment: The count-only 24-slot register has an additional physical family non-singlet attachment.
hypotheses.H6_readout_laws: The frozen heat-time, even-response, L/Q log-spectrum and affine-mean equations are the physical readout laws.
hypotheses.H7_residual_selection: The declared residual functional is physically minimized; this is not inferred from the existence of its mathematical minimum.
hypotheses.H8_chart_attachment: The six native coordinates have exactly the declared light-MSbar, heavy-self-scale and top-pole charts; a physical top pole and extraction relation are not derived.
hypotheses.H9_normalization: The D10 transmutation law supplies v/E_star and the external E_star GeV calibration supplies the absolute unit.
